prompt:
IMAGE TASK: CREATE ONE CANONICAL MULTI-VIEW REFERENCE BOARD
Asset: A0
Prompt: MVP1
CORE REQUIREMENT
Every panel must depict the exact same physical product. This board is the visual source of truth for all later video scenes.
SUBJECT IDENTITY LOCK
One realistic dark charcoal household refrigerator with a top-freezer two-door layout. The upper freezer door is clearly smaller than the lower refrigerator door. A thin brushed-silver horizontal trim separates the doors. Handles are minimal recessed vertical grips along the left door edges. The cabinet is a simple rectangular freestanding body with flat dark side panels, small adjustable feet, subtle panel seams, and no external water/ice dispenser. It must look like an ordinary mass-produced appliance that could physically exist in a home.
Must preserve in every panel:
- dark charcoal matte/satin coated-metal body
- two-door top-freezer architecture
- upper freezer door smaller than lower fresh-food door
- thin brushed-silver horizontal divider trim
- recessed vertical left-edge handle geometry
- same cabinet width-height-depth proportions
- same top panel, side-panel seams, feet and door thickness
- same subtle surface finish and edge radii
Must never change between panels:
- do not change door count or convert to French-door, side-by-side or bottom-freezer
- do not change body color or material between views
- do not add an ice/water dispenser, display panel, protruding bar handles or logo
- do not change the silver divider thickness or location
- do not change the depth, feet, top geometry or handle design between panels
- do not invent exposed internal refrigeration parts on the exterior
CAPTURE PROFILE
Capture mode: smartphone
Device class: modern flagship-class smartphone main camera, natural computational photography
Lens: 26 mm full-frame equivalent
Aperture: f/1.8
Shutter: 1/125s
ISO: 80
White balance: 5000 K
Camera height: 1.35 m
Subject distance: 2.4 m
Focus: single-point autofocus locked on the refrigerator body; keep the complete product sharp enough for documentation
Exposure: neutral indoor exposure around -0.1 EV; preserve dark-surface detail without lifted HDR shadows
Lighting: soft natural window daylight from camera-right plus weak ambient room fill; no studio flash
Stabilization: normal handheld optical/electronic stabilization; no artificial motion blur
Processing: natural smartphone JPEG/HEIC look with restrained HDR, neutral sharpening, realistic micro-contrast and no beauty/product-ad retouching
Capture realism rules:
- retain subtle sensor-like texture and ordinary household contrast
- avoid perfectly clean CGI gradients and mirror-smooth surfaces
- keep vertical edges believable and avoid ultra-wide stretching
- use realistic contact shadows and small imperfect reflections
REQUIRED VIEWS
1. FRONT [front]
   yaw: 0°
   pitch: 0°
   framing: full product, straight-on, entire top and feet visible with small margins
   purpose: lock door layout, proportions, trim and handle identity
2. FRONT LEFT 45° [front_left_45]
   yaw: -45°
   pitch: 0°
   framing: full product, front and left side both clearly visible
   purpose: lock cabinet depth and left-side geometry
3. FRONT RIGHT 45° [front_right_45]
   yaw: 45°
   pitch: 0°
   framing: full product, front and right side both clearly visible
   purpose: lock cabinet depth and right-side geometry
4. LEFT SIDE [left]
   yaw: -90°
   pitch: 0°
   framing: full product side elevation with front/rear edges readable
   purpose: lock side profile and depth
5. RIGHT SIDE [right]
   yaw: 90°
   pitch: 0°
   framing: full product side elevation with front/rear edges readable
   purpose: lock opposite side profile and depth
6. REAR LEFT 45° [rear_left_45]
   yaw: -135°
   pitch: 0°
   framing: full product with rear plane dominant and left side visible
   purpose: primary reference for rear-warm scenes
7. REAR RIGHT 45° [rear_right_45]
   yaw: 135°
   pitch: 0°
   framing: full product with rear plane dominant and right side visible
   purpose: secondary rear reference and cross-check
8. REAR [rear]
   yaw: 180°
   pitch: 0°
   framing: full straight rear elevation; complete back casing and feet visible
   purpose: lock rear exterior geometry without inventing internals
ENVIRONMENT
Location: ordinary modern home kitchen / utility area, clean but lived-in, with enough clearance around the appliance for documentation photography
Background: neutral light wall with restrained light-wood cabinetry kept secondary; no showroom sweep, no advertising set, no people
Floor: light neutral tile or wood-look flooring with realistic contact shadow
Lighting continuity: same soft daylight direction, color temperature and exposure logic in every panel
REFERENCE BOARD COMPOSITION
Layout: single 16:9 reference board, 4 columns × 2 rows, eight equal panels in required_views order
Labels: small plain uppercase labels below each panel: FRONT, FRONT LEFT 45°, FRONT RIGHT 45°, LEFT SIDE, RIGHT SIDE, REAR LEFT 45°, REAR RIGHT 45°, REAR; no other text
Panel rules:
- one refrigerator per panel and exactly eight panels total
- use the same apparent product scale across comparable full-body views
- keep panel backgrounds simple and visually consistent
- do not overlap products across panel boundaries
- make each view large enough to inspect handles, trim, panel seams and proportions
Crop rules:
- never crop the refrigerator top, feet, front/rear edges or side depth
- leave a small consistent margin around the complete appliance
- do not use close-up crops in this canonical board
CROSS-VIEW CONSISTENCY
- treat all panels as photographs of one exact physical refrigerator moved relative to the camera, never as separate design variations
- front width, cabinet depth and total height must remain geometrically coherent across orthogonal and 45-degree views
- door heights, silver divider, handle positions, feet, top surface and edge radii must align logically between adjacent views
- left and right side profiles must agree with the depth implied by both front 45-degree and rear 45-degree views
- rear width and height must match the front; rear casing must be plausible, restrained and consistent across rear/rear-45 panels
- lighting direction, body color, finish, exposure and background family must remain consistent across every panel
PHOTOGRAPHIC REALISM
- make each panel look like a real handheld smartphone product-documentation photograph, not a 3D render
- use natural coated-metal reflections, small household imperfections and plausible contact shadows
- preserve readable dark-surface detail without making the charcoal body glossy black
- avoid excessive depth of field blur; the full appliance must be documentable
- perspective must match a 26 mm-equivalent smartphone main camera at the stated distance and camera height
- avoid perfectly centered advertising symmetry except the straight front/rear elevation views
TECHNICAL SAFETY
- A0 documents only visible exterior geometry; do not reveal or fabricate compressor, condenser, refrigerant tubing, evaporator or hidden internals
- rear casing may include generic believable covers/vents only when necessary, but must not imply a specific undocumented refrigeration layout
- do not add heat arrows, thermal glow, labels other than view names, or explanatory graphics
NEGATIVE CONSTRAINTS
- no CGI, 3D-render, illustration or concept-art look
- no studio cyclorama or luxury showroom staging
- no people, hands or reflections of a photographer
- no logos, brand names, watermarks or advertising text
- no warped straight edges, duplicated handles, extra doors, missing feet or changing panel seams
- no different refrigerator model between views
- no ultra-wide fisheye distortion
- no dramatic bokeh, cinematic haze, bloom, neon rim light or unrealistic glow
- no open doors or visible interior in this board
- no invented exposed refrigeration components
OUTPUT
3072x1728, aspect ratio 16:9
Opaque background.
FINAL RULE
Do not create several similar products. Create one stable canonical product observed from multiple camera positions. Geometry, materials, proportions and distinguishing features must remain identical across every panel.
